select foodName, recipesId as recipesId, foodImg from recipes order by recipesId asc limit 4

SELECT r.recipesId, r.foodName, r.foodImg FROM recipes r WHERE r.categoryId = ( SELECT categoryId FROM ( SELECT r.categoryId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM favorites f JOIN recipes r ON f.recipeId = r.recipesId WHERE f.userId = #{id} GROUP BY r.categoryId ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS topCategory ) ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 4;
